name: SHOWTIME
source:
You, the player, go through your boring life in the office until a certain TV head man comes into your life and changes it forever.

[Edited from [url=https://loony-pendulum.itch.io/showtime]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玩家原本过着乏味的办公室生活，直到某个长着电视头的男人闯入你的生活，并彻底改变了一切。
